nights.title: KAMELOT - DARK ASYLUM WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Kamelot
nights.extract: Kamelot is an American power metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed by Thomas Youngblood in 1987. The Norwegian vocalist Roy Khan joined for the album Siége Perilous, and shared songwriting credit with Youngblood until his departure in April 2011. On June 22, 2012, Youngblood announced on their website that their new vocalist would be the Swedish singer Tommy Karevik, who was first featured on Kamelot's album Silverthorn as the main vocalist, co-songwriter, and lyricist.

facts: Der norwegische Sänger Roy Khan kam für das Album Siége Perilous hinzu und teilte sich das Songwriting mit Youngblood bis zu seinem Weggang im April 2011.

Am 22. Juni 2012 kündigte Youngblood auf der Website der Band an, dass der Schwede Tommy Karevik neuer Sänger werde; Karevik war zuvor als Hauptsänger, Co-Songwriter und Texter auf dem Album Silverthorn zu hören.

tr.kicker: amerikalı power metal grubu · tampa, florida, 1987
tr.who: Kamelot, Florida'nın Tampa kentinden, 1987'de Thomas Youngblood tarafından kurulmuş Amerikalı bir power metal grubudur. Norveçli vokalist Roy Khan, Siége Perilous albümü için gruba katıldı ve Nisan 2011'deki ayrılışına kadar Youngblood ile şarkı yazarlığı payını paylaştı.
facts: Norveçli vokalist Roy Khan, Siége Perilous albümü için gruba katıldı ve Nisan 2011'deki ayrılışına kadar Youngblood ile şarkı yazarlığı payını paylaştı.

22 Haziran 2012'de Youngblood, web sitesinde yeni vokalistin İsveçli şarkıcı Tommy Karevik olacağını duyurdu; Karevik daha önce Kamelot'un Silverthorn albümünde ana vokalist, ortak besteci ve söz yazarı olarak yer almıştı.

nights.title: The Kid LAROI - A Perfect World Tour
nights.name: The Kid Laroi
nights.extract: Charlton Kenneth Jeffrey Howard, known professionally as the Kid Laroi, is an Australian singer, rapper, and songwriter. He was signed with American rapper Lil Bibby's Grade A Productions, in a joint venture with Columbia Records, in 2019. He is best known for his 2021 single "Stay", which peaked atop the charts in numerous countries including his native Australia, as well as the Canadian Hot 100 and Billboard Hot 100.

nights.title: Sheer Terror
nights.name: Sheer Terror
nights.extract: Sheer Terror are an American hardcore punk band from New York City. The band was one of the first to combine elements of heavy metal with a hardcore punk base, pioneering a heavier style of hardcore that would create many bands in the following decades. Formed in late 1984, the band stayed together until 1998, through numerous lineup changes and shifts in musical style. In October 2004, the band reunited for two shows at New York City's CBGB Club.

nights.title: J. Cole: The Fall-Off Tour
nights.name: J. Cole
nights.extract: Jermaine Lamarr Cole is an American rapper and record producer. Born on a military base in Germany and raised in Fayetteville, North Carolina, Cole initially gained attention as a rapper following the release of his debut mixtape, The Come Up, in early 2007. He attended college in New York City with intent in furthering his musical career, and signed with Jay-Z's Roc Nation in 2009; the label released his next two mixtapes: The Warm Up (2009) and Friday Night Lights (2010), both of which earned him wider recognition.

nights.title: Dizzy DROS
nights.name: Dizzy DROS
nights.extract: Omar Souhaili, better known by his stage name Dizzy DROS, or just Dizzy, is a Moroccan rapper, songwriter and record producer. Souhaili first gained recognition with the release of his debut music video, "Casafonia" in 2011. The track received significant airplay on major Moroccan radio stations, including Hit Radio, Radio Mars, and Cap Radio, quickly establishing him as a rising star in the Moroccan rap scene and earning him a fanbase.
